text: 美联储Goolsbee：认同美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会演讲中的许多细节。 通胀问题显然还没有得到解决。 必须全神贯注于通胀是否是暂时的。 我可不会说“我曾对通胀（取得进展）丧失信心”。 对联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的开会次数没有强烈倾向。
text_en: Fed's Goolsbee: I agree with many details of Fed Chair Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole symposium. Inflation is clearly not yet resolved. Must stay focused on whether inflation is temporary. I would not say I have lost confidence in progress on inflation. No strong preference on the number of FOMC meetings.
